reviewNotes: Held back: not provably public domain: J. Rosamond Johnson: public domain needs a death year before 1955, work in print before 1850 ("activeBy"), or "traditional": true for an anonymous source; the key signature (doh Ab) and the incipit's doh (Eb) disagree. Imported from CCEH tune 000907 (the melody read from 000907a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 2 notes off in 22); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000907a.nwc). The tune ends on Ab, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
